review.intent_summary: The default recipe builds an expectation from earlier matching seasonal observations and a training-fitted level, linear, or compound-growth model.

criteria.criterion: A supplied season length selects earlier matching seasonal observations for the reference.
Automatic trend selection represents suitable linear and compound growth without flagging ordinary growth as point anomalies.
The fitted trend remains frozen after training within a regime; later changed values do not rewrite that fit.
Callers can explicitly select none, linear, or exponential trend, and unsupported trend modes are rejected.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected growth_up and compound: linear/exponential selections respectively, zero point episodes and zero patterns.
